    SEO for Nairobi brands that move the commercial needle

    The search landscape across Nairobi is competitive, no matter what you’re selling, which makes it all the more important that any brand looking to make an impact in their sector opts for a strategic approach that encompasses all facets of organic search.

    • Technical SEO

    • Core Web Vitals

    Our SEO services for Nairobi businesses encompass everything listed and come with well-defined expectations. And while you shouldn’t expect organic search campaigns to transform your business overnight, you can expect them to be a predictable generator of leads when it’s aligned with your website’s conversion journey and other insights, which is exactly what our team does.

    Contact

    • Technical SEO

      Technical SEO involves fixing and optimising a range of features that might not be visible to the customer, but can do real damage to your website and your bottom line if left to persist. Our SEO teams work in tandem with web designers to fix existing gaps and ensure a solid platform for future success.

    • Content Marketing

      An SEO campaign is nothing without words. And at Chuech Studio, we take your website’s words seriously. The compelling content we create, as well as attracting traffic from relevant audiences, encourages them to take action, be that inquiring or buying. Whatever content we create for you will fill your site with the persuasive buying signals needed in a busy market.

    • Authority Building

      Being seen as trusted and authoritative is vital if you want the levels of online visibility that translate into revenue. We help you earn important third-party endorsements in the form of links and mentions through careful selection of targets and the creation of high-quality campaigns that industry publications and relevant sites can’t help but be impressed by.

    • Local SEO

      For many businesses, a lot of their audience will be on their doorstep, and local SEO campaigns for Nairobi businesses can help people get to know your organisation, whether they live in Westlands, Kilimani, or Karen. Whether it’s through dedicated location pages or optimising Google Business Profiles, Chuech Studio’s local SEO campaigns are always tied back to commercial outcomes.

    • Keyword Research

      We carry out extensive research into your industry’s search landscape to select terms that we can then target with engaging, relevant content. Behind each term is intent which we meet to ensure the highest chance of conversion. Targeting terms across the sales funnel, we make sure your brand is seen no matter where a customer is in the purchasing journey.

    • AI SEO

      In recent years, AI search engines have transformed how people search and have meant businesses need to ensure their content not only targets terms but that it can be understood by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Copilot. We’ll help your business navigate this new evolution of search so that you feel the benefits, not the uncertainty, of it.

    How we run your SEO campaigns

    All the SEO work we do for your business is centred on your goals and priorities. We start by looking at your current digital presence and creating a prioritisation plan based on the data. We’ll then address the immediate issues before putting in the foundations for long-term success, which will be different for every business. We don’t stick to a rigid 5-step process like most agencies. Instead, our team prefers to operate against a rolling roadmap that can be adjusted should your business priorities change. We can also work alongside in-house teams if that’s the sort of support your Nairobi business needs.
